title: 1987 Philippine Constitution: Review Foundation
summary: A concise map of constitutional principles, rights, government structure, and accountability for focused review.

notes.heading: Principles and state policies
notes.body: Review the constitutional commitment to a democratic and republican state, the rule of law, human dignity, social justice, and integrity in public service.

notes.heading: Bill of Rights and due process
notes.body: Focus on the protection of individual liberty, equal protection, due process, and safeguards against unreasonable government action.

notes.heading: Government structure
notes.body: Distinguish the legislative, executive, and judicial functions, and understand why separation of powers and checks and balances matter.

notes.heading: Accountability and public trust
notes.body: Public office is a public trust. Accountability, constitutional commissions, elections, and responsible citizenship connect authority with service to the people.

let.rationale: Civic and government concepts support general-education review.
let.official_scope_status: editorial foundation; not an exam prediction

civil-service.rationale: General-information and public-service preparation use constitutional foundations.
civil-service.official_scope_status: editorial foundation; not an exam prediction

criminologist.rationale: Rights, authority, due process, and accountability are relevant foundations for justice-oriented study.
criminologist.official_scope_status: editorial foundation; not an exam prediction

title: RA 6713: Public-Service Ethics Review
summary: A source-backed review outline of the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees.

notes.heading: Purpose and public interest
notes.body: The law promotes a high standard of ethics and treats public office as a responsibility to serve the public interest.

notes.heading: Norms of conduct
notes.body: Review commitment to public interest, professionalism, justness and sincerity, political neutrality, responsiveness, nationalism and patriotism, commitment to democracy, and simple living.

notes.heading: Duties and transparency
notes.body: Focus on duties to respond to the public, process documents properly, and disclose relevant business interests and financial connections as required.

notes.heading: Prohibited acts and accountability
notes.body: Understand that conflicts of interest, prohibited transactions, and violations of the law can create administrative and legal accountability.

civil-service.rationale: The statute is a direct public-service ethics foundation.
civil-service.official_scope_status: source-backed study material; not an exam prediction

criminologist.rationale: Professional accountability and public-service ethics provide relevant civic context.
criminologist.official_scope_status: editorial extension; not an exam prediction

title: Human Rights and Public Accountability
summary: A concise review guide connecting human dignity, rights protections, and accountable public authority.

notes.heading: Human dignity
notes.body: The Constitution recognizes the value of every person and requires public authority to respect protected rights.

notes.heading: Rights in practice
notes.body: Connect due process, equal protection, and lawful exercise of government power to responsible public service.

notes.heading: Review focus
notes.body: Use this foundation to distinguish a protected right from an administrative preference and to ask whether government action has lawful basis.

notes.heading: Universal principles
notes.body: Human dignity, equality, and freedoms are treated as universal principles while Philippine constitutional protections provide the local civic frame.

civil-service.rationale: Rights and accountability are core civic foundations for public-service review.
civil-service.official_scope_status: source-backed study material; not an exam prediction

criminologist.rationale: Rights and lawful authority are relevant to justice-oriented foundations.
criminologist.official_scope_status: editorial foundation; not an exam prediction

let.rationale: Rights and accountable authority support civic reasoning within General Education.
let.official_scope_status: editorial civic foundation; not an exam prediction

notes.body: Distinguish behaviorist, cognitive, constructivist, humanist, and sociocultural views of learning.

notes.heading: Practice next
